archetype_description: A hybrid of 'Organic & Earthy' (for food/nutrition) and 'Performance Pro' (for elite fitness/health tracking). Primary palette relies heavily on stark whites and deep, vibrant emerald greens.
design_philosophy: Elite Performance Nutrition. The UI should feel like a premium health coaching app, not a typical clunky university mess portal. High contrast, precise data visualization, and immersive food imagery.

spacing_and_layout.container: max-w-md mx-auto w-full min-h-screen bg-white shadow-2xl relative pb-20

buttons.primary: bg-[#059669] hover:bg-[#047857] text-white font-bold rounded-xl px-6 py-3 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center
buttons.secondary: bg-[#D1FAE5] hover:bg-[#A7F3D0] text-[#065F46] font-bold rounded-xl px-6 py-3 transition-colors
buttons.ghost: bg-transparent hover:bg-gray-100 text-[#022C22] font-semibold rounded-xl px-4 py-2

cards.default: bg-white border border-[#E2E8F0] shadow-sm rounded-2xl p-5
cards.highlight: bg-[#022C22] text-white border border-[#064E3B] shadow-lg rounded-2xl p-5

inputs.default: w-full bg-[#F8FAF9] border border-[#E2E8F0] rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-[#022C22] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#10B981] focus:border-transparent outline-none transition-all placeholder:text-gray-400

bottom_nav.container: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 max-w-md mx-auto bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-gray-100 flex justify-around items-center h-20 px-2 z-50
bottom_nav.item_inactive: flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600

tabs.list: flex p-1 space-x-1 bg-[#F8FAF9] rounded-xl border border-gray-100
tabs.trigger_active: w-full rounded-lg py-2.5 text-sm font-bold bg-white text-[#059669] shadow-sm
tabs.trigger_inactive: w-full rounded-lg py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50

login_hero.description: Premium dark-themed Indian food dish, used for the two-column split login background.

dashboard_texture.description: Green abstract texture, use sparingly for high-end accent cards or premium stats backgrounds with dark overlay.

meal_placeholder_1.description: Healthy salad bowl for lunch/dinner meal items.

meal_placeholder_2.description: Indian bowl dish for dinner menu items.

meal_placeholder_3.description: Rich Indian dish for special/premium meal items.

data_testid_convention: All interactive elements must use kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g., login-submit-button, meal-rating-star, menu-tab-lunch).
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first web app within a 'max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen' container to simulate a mobile app interface. Add shadow to the container to distinguish it on desktop screens.
Implement bottom navigation tabs for mobile view instead of a sidebar.
Use the specified Cabinet Grotesk font for headings to deliver an 'Elite Performance' vibe.
Login Screen: Implement a split or overlaid layout using the 'login_hero' image. The form should feel like an elite fitness app.
Student Dashboard: Use the 'bento_grid' pattern for daily energy stats (Kcal, Protein, Carbs, Fats). Underneath, use 'tabs' for Breakfast/Lunch/Dinner to show today's menu.
Meal Planner: Build a weekly calendar horizontal scroll (MON-SUN) with diet tabs (Veg/Non-Veg/Special).
Meal Rating: Implement star ratings and serving size controls with a clean UI. Show nutritional breakdown per item in a compact, dense format.
Use Lucide-React icons heavily for visual indicators (flame for calories, star for rating, etc).
Admin Dashboard: Ensure analytics cards are dense and data-rich. Use red/green colors for waste risk and demand metrics.
